title: Implement Export Design Model GLB/glTF
description: Implement export_design_model function in compose.rs that exports a design's 3D model to GLB/glTF format. BFS to compute world planes, merge type meshes, build GLB binary.
summary: Implemented export_design_model function and supporting helpers in compose.rs. The function exports a design's assembled 3D model to GLB/glTF format by: (1) BFS traversal to compute world transforms for all pieces via connection graph, (2) per-type mesh assembly by parsing embedded GLB models or generating box placeholders, (3) building a hierarchical glTF scene graph matching the connection hierarchy with local transforms. Added: EXPORT_MODEL_FORMATS constant, decode_data_uri_blob, parse_glb, build_glb, matrix4_to_gltf_column_major, append_box_mesh, select_model_for_type, merge_glb_mesh helpers. All 11 existing tests pass.
